gui.techquest.quests.title: Quests
gui.techquest.quest.select: Select a quest on the left. You can drag the tree with the mouse.
gui.techquest.quest.locked: Locked: claim the previous quests first
quest.techquest.missing_items: You don't have enough items to hand in
quest.techquest.welcome.title: Welcome to TechQuest
quest.techquest.welcome.desc:
Open the quest book. Path: energy → machines → logistics → chemistry → automation → hazardous power.

WORKS: most creative-tab blocks. Claim rewards with the button.
quest.techquest.tin_ore.title: Tin Ore
quest.techquest.tin_ore.desc:
Mine tin ore (stone & deepslate).

WORKS: worldgen, raw tin drops.
quest.techquest.tin_ingot.title: Tin Ingot
quest.techquest.tin_ingot.desc:
Smelt raw tin.

WORKS: vanilla furnace smelting.
quest.techquest.bronze.title: Bronze
quest.techquest.bronze.desc:
Craft bronze (tin + copper).

WORKS: crafting, unlocks casings.
quest.techquest.casing.title: Machine Casing
quest.techquest.casing.desc:
Craft Machine Casings — base of all machines.

WORKS: crafting ingredient.
quest.techquest.generator.title: Coal Generator
quest.techquest.generator.desc:
Place it, insert coal, connect cables.

WORKS: coal → FE, GUI, pushes energy.
quest.techquest.circuit.title: Circuits
quest.techquest.circuit.desc:
Craft basic circuits for mid-game.

WORKS: crafting.
quest.techquest.macerator.title: Macerator
quest.techquest.macerator.desc:
Crush ores into dust for better yield.

WORKS: GUI, recipes, energy.
quest.techquest.dust.title: Dusts
quest.techquest.dust.desc:
Macerator dusts for ore multiplication.

WORKS: dust chain.
quest.techquest.cable.title: Cables
quest.techquest.cable.desc:
Craft tin cables, link generator to machines.

WORKS: FE transfer, auto-connect. LV/MV/HV have limits and loss.
quest.techquest.compressor.title: Compressor
quest.techquest.compressor.desc:
Compress ingots into plates.

WORKS: GUI, FE, plate recipes.
quest.techquest.plates.title: Plates
quest.techquest.plates.desc:
Compressor plates for recipes.

WORKS: plate crafts.
quest.techquest.electric_furnace.title: Electric Furnace
quest.techquest.electric_furnace.desc:
Smelt with FE instead of coal.

WORKS: GUI, energy smelting.
quest.techquest.solar.title: Solar Panel
quest.techquest.solar.desc:
Free FE during daytime.

WORKS: day generation only.
quest.techquest.battery.title: Battery Box
quest.techquest.battery.desc:
Energy buffer between gen and machines.

WORKS: stores and I/O FE via cables.
quest.techquest.industrial.title: Industrial Empire
quest.techquest.industrial.desc:
Gather 8 advanced circuits — main TechQuest path complete.

WORKS: finale reward.
quest.techquest.wind.title: Wind Turbine
quest.techquest.wind.desc:
Place turbine, install a blade (RMB). Blades wear out.

WORKS: 6 blade types, durability, power, spinning render.
quest.techquest.water.title: Water Wheel
quest.techquest.water.desc:
Place next to water. May slowly consume nearby water.

WORKS: FE from water, slow water drain.
quest.techquest.lead.title: Lead
quest.techquest.lead.desc:
Lead for shielding and nuclear crafts.

WORKS: ore and items.
quest.techquest.silver.title: Silver
quest.techquest.drill.title: Drill Multiblock
quest.techquest.drill.desc:
Controller + frames cross + head below. Shift+RMB to form.

WORKS: structure check, powered drilling.
quest.techquest.alloy.title: Alloy Smelter
quest.techquest.alloy.desc:
Multiblock: casing below and above controller.

WORKS: structure + alloy recipes.
message.techquest.wind.has_blades: Already has blades. Break to remove.
message.techquest.wind.need_sky: Need open sky above the turbine!
message.techquest.drill.hint3: 3) Drill Head under controller, then Shift+Right-click
message.techquest.water.nerfed: Water wheel generates less FE and slowly consumes water
tooltip.techquest.exo.install_hint: Hold exo + module in hands, right-click
message.techquest.blast.hint: Need 3x3x3 of Machine Casings with controller in center middle layer
quest.techquest.conveyor.title: Conveyors
quest.techquest.conveyor.desc:
Belts move items. Flammables + fire spread fire. Sealed belts are safer.

WORKS: item movement, fire, radiation leak on open belts, redstone speeds up.
quest.techquest.tier_cable.title: Cable Tiers
quest.techquest.tier_cable.desc:
LV → MV → HV. Higher tier = more FE/t, less loss.

WORKS: transfer caps and loss %.
quest.techquest.energy_meter.title: Energy Meter
quest.techquest.energy_meter.desc:
RMB on machine/cable to read FE and cable tier.

WORKS: readout tool.
quest.techquest.oil.title: Oil
quest.techquest.oil.desc:
Mine oil deposits (Y 16–80 in stone).

WORKS: worldgen, crude oil drops.
quest.techquest.refinery.title: Refinery
quest.techquest.refinery.desc:
FE + crude oil → mazut, gasoline, lubricant (+plastic chance).

WORKS: full GUI processing.
quest.techquest.reactor_chem.title: Chemical Reactor
quest.techquest.reactor_chem.desc:
2 inputs → composites (carbon fiber, kevlar, rocket fuel, steel).

WORKS: GUI recipes.
quest.techquest.steel.title: Steel
quest.techquest.steel.desc:
Steel for quarry, boiler, multiblocks.

WORKS: craft / chem recipes.
quest.techquest.quarry.title: Quarry
quest.techquest.quarry.desc:
GUI: whitelist filter, buffer, ON/OFF. Digs 9×9 down.

WORKS: GUI filter, energy mining.
quest.techquest.exo.title: Exoskeleton
quest.techquest.exo.desc:
Wear chest. Module in one hand, exo in other → RMB to install.

WORKS: servo/plating/filter/battery effects.
quest.techquest.greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
quest.techquest.greenhouse.desc:
Speeds crop growth in radius, uses FE.

WORKS: bonemeal-like ticks.
quest.techquest.boiler.title: Steam Boiler
quest.techquest.boiler.desc:
Coal + water → heat, pressure, FE. High pressure without cooling/valve = EXPLOSION.

WORKS: GUI bars, explosion, safety blocks.
quest.techquest.safety.title: Plant Safety
quest.techquest.safety.desc:
Place valve or cooling tower next to boiler.

WORKS: vents pressure / cools; prevents boom.
quest.techquest.sprinkler.title: Sprinkler
quest.techquest.sprinkler.desc:
Redstone-powered: puts out fires and burning conveyors.

WORKS: extinguish in radius.
quest.techquest.uranium.title: Uranium
quest.techquest.uranium.desc:
Craft uranium ingot (temp recipe: iron+emerald+redstone).

WORKS: reactor fuel.
quest.techquest.nuclear.title: Nuclear Reactor
quest.techquest.nuclear.desc:
Huge FE, heat & radiation. Need cooling + scrubber. Overheat = meltdown.

WORKS: GUI, spent fuel, rad, explosion risk.
quest.techquest.vitrify.title: Vitrification
quest.techquest.vitrify.desc:
Spent fuel + sand/glass + FE → safe glassed waste.

WORKS: processing machine.
quest.techquest.rtg.title: RTG
quest.techquest.rtg.desc:
Insert glassed waste → 2 FE/t forever.

WORKS: passive generation.
quest.techquest.blast.title: Blast Furnace
quest.techquest.blast.desc:
3×3×3 machine casings, controller at center middle. Shift+RMB or wrench to form.

WORKS: multiblock smelting, 4 inputs, FE.
quest.techquest.laser.title: Laser Drill
quest.techquest.laser.desc:
1×1 shaft down, heavy FE. Bedrock pulses may yield uranium/diamonds.

WORKS: toggle, buffer, beam particles.
quest.techquest.assembly.title: Assembly Line
quest.techquest.assembly.desc:
3 inputs → advanced parts. Nearby conveyors speed it up.

WORKS: GUI recipes + belt bonus.
